SELECT tt.from_user_name AS senderName, tt.text AS questionContent, tt.msg_sent_time AS questionTime, tt.group_name AS groupName, tt.group_id AS groupId, tt.ics_msg_id AS icsMsgId, tcp.post_name AS postName, tcp.org_name AS orgName, tcp.related_user_names AS postUserNames, tcp.related_user_ids as relatedUserIds, tt.user_id as userId, tte.create_time as overDueTime, IF(tt.status = 8, false, true) as isHandle, tt.gmt_modified as handleTime FROM tb_task_expired tte LEFT JOIN tb_task tt ON tte.task_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN tb_collaboration_post tcp ON tt.post_id = tcp.id WHERE tcp.deleted = 0
AND tcp.org_code in
#{code}
AND tte.create_time >= #{startTime}
AND tte.create_time <=CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
AND tcp.post_name LIKE concat('%',#{keywords},'%')
ORDER BY tte.create_time DESC
